id: 03_Massive Open Online Course (MOOC) Introduction to Biorisk Management
title: 生物风险管理，人人有份（国内版）
source_doc: course/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/03_Massive Open Online Course (MOOC) Introduction to Biorisk Management.md
author_source: project/BIORISK MANAGEMENT/03_Massive Open Online Course (MOOC) Introduction to Biorisk Management（国内版）/src.py

points.K3: 管好风险，研究才能前进
points.K8: 进高风险区前穿戴防护

shots.scene: 欣欣站在教室讲台旁，身后屏幕只有图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a podium in a classroom with a screen showing only icons, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到生物风险管理课。
overlay: 生物风险管理，人人有份

shots.scene: 欣欣翻开空白课程手册，五张日历页
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens a blank course booklet showing five calendar page icons.
shots.narration: 接下来几周，我们一步步学。

shots.scene: 老李在走廊里拦住小研，表情疑惑
shots.prompt_en: In a corridor, the facility engineer stops the female graduate student with a puzzled look.
shots.narration: 老李问：我管设备，也要学这个？

shots.scene: 阿杰在旁边举手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand beside them.
shots.narration: 阿杰也问：我只是做实验的学生呢？

shots.scene: 小研微笑，指向墙上一张空白人员关系图
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student smiles and points at a blank wall chart with several people icons connected in a circle.
shots.narration: 小研说：管病原的事，人人有份。

shots.scene: 一圈人物图标：管理员、负责人、工程师、研究生、技术员
shots.prompt_en: A circle of people outline icons: an administrator, a manager, an engineer, a researcher and a technician, joined around a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 这门课面向所有和病原打交道的人：

shots.scene: 王老师、老周、老李站成一排
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator, the older man and the facility engineer stand in a row and nod.
shots.narration: 安全管理人员、负责人、设施管理员，

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰站在一起
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student stand together in lab coats.
shots.narration: 还有研究人员和实验技术人员。

shots.scene: 细菌和病毒图标越来越多
shots.prompt_en: Bacterium and virus icons multiplying across the frame. No people.
shots.narration: 细菌、病毒等生物因子，

shots.scene: 人群图标上方的警示三角变大
shots.prompt_en: A yellow warning triangle grows larger above a crowd of people outline icons. No people.
shots.narration: 对公众健康的威胁越来越大。

shots.section_title: 管好风险，研究才能前进
shots.scene: 检测试剂盒和药瓶图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank diagnostic test kit and a blank medicine bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 要研发诊断方法和治疗药物，
overlay: 管好风险，研究才能前进

shots.section_title: 管好风险，研究才能前进
shots.scene: 实验室外围有盾牌圈，里面研究顺利进行
shots.prompt_en: A shield ring around a laboratory icon, with a green arrow moving forward inside it. No people.
shots.narration: 先得把风险管好，研究才走得远。

shots.scene: 三个台阶：放大镜、盾牌、对勾
shots.prompt_en: Three steps with a magnifier icon, a shield icon and a check mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 课程分三部分。

shots.scene: 三个图标连成循环
shots.prompt_en: The three icons join into a turning circle of arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 评估、减缓、绩效，连成一个循环。

shots.scene: 放大镜在样品盒上移动，找出红色风险点
shots.prompt_en: A magnifier moves over a sample box and a pipette icon, highlighting small red risk dots. No people.
shots.narration: 第一，学会做风险评估，

shots.scene: 小研在空白评估表上圈出几项
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student circles several items on a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 找出这个病原、这项操作的具体风险。

shots.scene: 五块积木叠成墙
shots.prompt_en: Five building blocks stacked into a protective wall, each with a different icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，学会用五类控制措施，

shots.scene: 红色风险点穿过积木墙后变小
shots.prompt_en: Red risk dots pass the five-block wall and come out small and pale. No people.
shots.narration: 把找到的风险降下来。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白检查表打勾
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator ticks items on a blank checklist in the laboratory.
shots.narration: 第三，学会评价这些措施，

shots.scene: 仪表盘指针指向绿色
shots.prompt_en: A gauge with a needle pointing to green, beside a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 看它们是不是真的管用。

shots.section_title: 进高风险区前穿戴防护
shots.scene: 缓冲间里小研穿上连体防护服
shots.prompt_en: In an anteroom, the female graduate student puts on a white coverall and gloves; a blank poster with icons hangs on the wall.
shots.narration: 进入高风险区域前，先在缓冲间穿戴。
overlay: 进高风险区前穿戴防护

shots.section_title: 进高风险区前穿戴防护
shots.scene: 小研戴上电动送风头罩，老周在旁检查
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a powered air-purifying respirator hood while the older man checks the fit at her neck.
shots.narration: 按评估选用防护，如送风式呼吸器。

shots.section_title: 进高风险区前穿戴防护
shots.scene: 绿色对勾的检查图标：电池、风量、密合
shots.prompt_en: Three check icons: a battery, an airflow arrow and a sealed hood outline, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 用前检查，经过培训才能使用。

shots.scene: 生物安全柜内，套袋的废物容器
shots.prompt_en: Inside a biological safety cabinet, a waste container lined with a plastic bag stands at the back of the work surface. No people.
shots.narration: 安全柜里的废物，放在套袋容器里。

shots.scene: 戴手套的手向袋口喷消毒剂
shots.prompt_en: Gloved hands spray disinfectant onto the top of the waste bag inside the cabinet.
shots.narration: 处理前先消毒，再按规定带出处置。

shots.scene: 三层金字塔：学校、学院、实验室
shots.prompt_en: A three-level pyramid icon: a campus at the top, a department building in the middle and a laboratory room at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 高校实验室安全，实行三级管理。

shots.scene: 生物安全委员会会议桌
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the older man sit at a committee table with blank documents and a biohazard warning sign on a stand.
shots.narration: 单位设生物安全委员会，把关审核。

shots.scene: 老周胸前出现第一责任人徽章
shots.prompt_en: The older man wears a badge icon and stands in front of his laboratory door.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人，是第一责任人。

shots.scene: 老李检查设施，阿杰按规程操作
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a ventilation unit while the young male student follows a blank procedure sheet at his bench.
shots.narration: 管设施的、做实验的，各守其责。

shots.scene: 一个研究成果图标分出两条路：绿色帮助与红色危害
shots.prompt_en: A research result icon splits into two paths: a green path to a hospital icon and a red path to a warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 有的研究成果，可用来救人，

shots.scene: 红色那条路被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The red path to the warning triangle is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 也可能被误用，这叫两用研究。

shots.scene: 老周把空白方案交给伦理审查小组
shots.prompt_en: The older man hands a blank research plan to the safety administrator at an ethics review table.
shots.narration: 研究方案要经伦理和安全审查。

shots.scene: 阿杰发现异常请求，向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks at a suspicious blank email icon and reports it to the older man.
shots.narration: 发现可疑请求，及时报告。

shots.scene: 三层包装示意：管、袋、硬质外箱
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of three-layer packaging: a sealed tube, a leak-proof bag with absorbent pad, and a rigid outer box with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 样本送检，要密封、三层包装。

shots.scene: 小研提着密封转运箱走过走廊
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries a sealed transport box with a biohazard warning sign along a corridor.
shots.narration: 校内转运，用专用密封箱，专人送。

shots.scene: 手提开口试管走路的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand carrying an open tube while walking, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能手拿开口管子到处走。

shots.scene: 空白审批单和印章
shots.prompt_en: A blank approval document with a stamp mark next to a sealed transport box. No people.
shots.narration: 高致病性样本的运输，必须经审批。

shots.scene: 欣欣身边围着一圈人物图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in the middle of a circle of people outline icons.
shots.narration: 管病原的风险，人人有份。

shots.scene: 三个台阶与五块积木
shots.prompt_en: Icons of the three steps and the five-block wall. No people.
shots.narration: 会评估、会控制、会检查。

shots.scene: 金字塔、伦理天平、三层包装图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a three-level pyramid, a balance scale and a three-layer package. No people.
shots.narration: 守职责、守伦理，样本运输要合规。

shots.scene: 欣欣合上课程手册挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot closes a blank course booklet and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 一起学好这门课，下次见！
